```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork) 

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2) 
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 
```


```{r Run cellchat for control samples}


KA_seurat <- subset(KA_seurat_plots,subset= condition=="Control")

classes_filtering<-list("Choroid Plexus", "Vascular cells", "Microglia", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes",
                        "Oligo Progenitor Cells", "DG-PIR Immature Neurons", "Dentate Gyrus Neurons", "CTX-CGE GABA",
                        "Immature GABA Neurons", "VIP GABA Neurons", "Lamp5 GABA Neurons", "Pvalb GABA Neurons", "Sst GABA Neurons",                                        "NP CT L6b Glut","IT-ET Glut Neurons", "SUB-ProS Glut Neurons", "HPF CR Glut Neurons", "CA3 Glut Neurons",
                        "CA2 Glut Neurons", "CA1 Glut Neurons")
KA_seurat <- subset(KA_seurat,subset= classes %in% classes_filtering)
KA_seurat@meta.data$classes <- droplevels(KA_seurat@meta.data$classes)

data.input <- GetAssayData(KA_seurat, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts") 
data.input <- CellChat::normalizeData(data.input) 

Idents(KA_seurat)<- KA_seurat$classes
labels <- Idents(KA_seurat) 

meta <- data.frame(labels = labels, row.names = names(labels)) 


meta <- data.frame(
  labels = KA_seurat$classes,
  samples = as.character(droplevels(KA_seurat$sample.origin))
)
rownames(meta) <- colnames(KA_seurat)


cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels") 
  
#We select the database relevant to our project
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse 


CellChatDB.use <- CellChatDB 

  

# set the used database in the object 

cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use 


cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) 

future::plan("multisession", workers = 8) # do parallel 

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat) 

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat) 


  
execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm 
print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs")) #check how long it takes




  
ptm = Sys.time() 

cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean",trim = 0.1) #more relaxed method

cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10)


df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat) 

  

cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat) 
  
  

cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat) 

execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm 

print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs")) 



# netVisual_aggregate(cellchat, signaling = , layout = "chord") 
saveRDS(cellchat,"./cellchat_Control_trimean_01.rds")


``` 


```{r Run cellchat for epi samples}



ptm = Sys.time() 

KA_seurat <- subset(KA_seurat_plots,subset= condition=="Epi")

classes_filtering<-list("Choroid Plexus", "Vascular cells", "Microglia", "Astrocytes", "Oligodendrocytes",
                        "Oligo Progenitor Cells", "DG-PIR Immature Neurons", "Dentate Gyrus Neurons", "CTX-CGE GABA",
                        "Immature GABA Neurons", "VIP GABA Neurons", "Lamp5 GABA Neurons", "Pvalb GABA Neurons", "Sst GABA Neurons",                                        "NP CT L6b Glut","IT-ET Glut Neurons", "SUB-ProS Glut Neurons", "HPF CR Glut Neurons", "CA3 Glut Neurons",
                        "CA2 Glut Neurons", "CA1 Glut Neurons")
KA_seurat <- subset(KA_seurat,subset= classes %in% classes_filtering)
KA_seurat@meta.data$classes <- droplevels(KA_seurat@meta.data$classes)


data.input <- GetAssayData(KA_seurat, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts") 
data.input <- CellChat::normalizeData(data.input) 

Idents(KA_seurat)<- KA_seurat$classes
labels <- Idents(KA_seurat) 

meta <- data.frame(labels = labels, row.names = names(labels)) 


meta <- data.frame(
  labels = KA_seurat$classes,
  samples = as.character(droplevels(KA_seurat$sample.origin))
)
rownames(meta) <- colnames(KA_seurat)
  

  

cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels") 

  

  

CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse 

CellChatDB.use <- CellChatDB 

  

cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use 

  


cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) 

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat) 

cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat) 


  

execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm 

print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs")) 




ptm = Sys.time() 

cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean",trim = 0.1) #more relaxed method

  
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 10) 

  


df.net <- subsetCommunication(cellchat) 

  

cellchat <- computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat) 

  

cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat) 

execution.time = Sys.time() - ptm 

print(as.numeric(execution.time, units = "secs")) 

saveRDS(cellchat,"./cellchat_Epi_trimean_01.rds")


``` 

```{r Comparison analysis of epi/control datasets}

ptm = Sys.time()
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)


data.dir <- './comparison'
dir.create(data.dir)
setwd(data.dir)

###Read objects first
object.list <- list(Control = cellchat.PBS, Epi = cellchat.KA)
cellchat <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))

saveRDS(cellchat,"./cellchat_comp.rds")

```
